#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-stage scale buffers once for all blocks, amortizing the restriding
  // cost across all BLOCKS_M * BLOCKS_N iterations.
  const int GK = MATMUL_K / 32;

  // Static pre-staged scale arrays: [block_idx][scale_group][elem_in_block]
  // Sized for the maximum number of blocks along each dimension.
  static uint8_t pre_A_s[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t pre_B_s[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time restride: copy from strided A_scales_row[g][i0*BLK] into
  // contiguous pre_A_s[i0][g][0..BLK-1], done once before the main loop.
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_A_s[i0][g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_B_s[j0][g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

  // Configure Gemmini execution parameters once at the beginning
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    // Partial last M block: compute only the real rows, pad the rest.
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division for actual tiles needed
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    int tiles_J = BLK / DIM;  // Always process full BLK width for B
    
    uint32_t a_base = 0;
    uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;  // Place B at top
    int SPAD_DEST = 0;  // Use beginning of accumulator for output

    // Hoist scale factor load for A (once per i0 block row)
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_A_s[i0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

    // Hoist scratchpad load of A (once per i0 block row)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));      // A rows: stride K (full block-aligned tiles)
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        int a_row = i0 * BLK + i * DIM;
        if (a_row < REAL_M) {  // Only load if within valid range
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + a_row * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
    }
    
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last N block: compute only the real cols, pad the rest.
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;
      if (pad_i < 0) pad_i = 0;

      // Load scale factors for B
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_B_s[j0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Load B matrix tiles into the scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Configure requantizer bounds and scale selections
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Compute weight-stationary tiled matmul in hardware
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Readout packed results from the hardware shared memory (smem)
      int output_tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Actual output tiles in I direction
      for (int i = 0; i < output_tiles_I; i++) {
        int rows_in_tile = DIM;
        if (i == output_tiles_I - 1 && mrows % DIM != 0) {
          rows_in_tile = mrows % DIM;
        }
        
        for (int r = 0; r < rows_in_tile; r++) {
          int global_row = i0 * BLK + i * DIM + r;
          if (global_row < REAL_M) {
            // Calculate correct output position considering BF16 packing (4 per word)
            int out_col_words = (j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD;
            int col_offset = (j0 * BLK) % BF16_PER_WORD;
            gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[global_row][out_col_words],
                                 (SPAD_DEST + (i * BLK + r * BLK)) * 16 / BF16_PER_WORD, 
                                 ncols);
          }
        }
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
